function: UBFNet, a deep-unfolded E-TMMBF with trained matrix-inversion modules, computes the MU-MIMO downlink beamformer that maximizes weighted sum-rate (p. 6-8).
system: Single-cell MU-MIMO downlink: BS with N=64 or 128 antennas, K=4-12 users with 4 antennas each, 3.5 GHz, 20 MHz; no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: Deep unfolding of E-TMMBF into 6 layers with trainable inversion modules and offsets; unsupervised offline training with negative WSR loss, SGD, batch 20, 20 epochs (p. 7-10).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa implementation of 3GPP 3D MIMO model, scenario 3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS, 3.5 GHz, 20 MHz; 10,000 train, 1,000 validation, 1,000 test samples from different seeds (p. 9-10).
test_conditions: Main tests on 1,000 new-seed samples at 30 dB SNR; generalization: UBFNet-12-128 tested with fewer users and antennas, SNR below the training value, and imperfect CSI (p. 10-12).
baselines: Classical: WMMSE [14], own TMMBF and E-TMMBF, truncated E-TMMBF (no learning). Learned: IAIDNN [33], GCNWMMSE [31], UMIF [27], all deep unfolding with six layers (p. 10).
metrics: Sum-rate (bit/s/Hz) versus users, SNR and CSI error; convergence curves; CPU execution time; sum-rate retention percentage in generalization tests (p. 10-12).
complexity: Big-O orders (Table II, p. 8), parameter count (Eqs. 55-56), CPU time: UBFNet about 35x and 25x faster than WMMSE in Cases 1 and 2 (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 9: "is implemented in the QuaDRiGa channel simulator [40]"; the scenario is 3GPP_38.901_UMa_NLOS, used for training and testing.
q2_support: p. 12: "The trained UBFNet is tested on scenarios with smaller K" and N, after training for K=12, N=128; Tables IV and V give the sum-rate retained.
q3_support: p. 10: "1) WMMSE [14], which is the classical algorithm for" precoding, and "3) IAIDNN [33], which is a deep-unfolding framework", plus GCNWMMSE and UMIF; Fig. 3 (p. 11) compares the sum-rate of all.
q4_support: p. 8: "Table II lists the computational complexity in the inference stage for the compared algorithms"; CPU times are in Fig. 4 and the text on p. 11.
q5_support: p. 9: "We generate a dataset of channel realizations" with QuaDRiGa. Missing: no link to code or data, and the dataset is generated by the authors, not a public one.
notes: Area 3: the learned method is UBFNet, which outputs the MU-MIMO beamformer; TMMBF and E-TMMBF are the paper's non-learned algorithms and serve as baselines and as the unfolded skeleton. q2 is met by the test of UBFNet-12-128 on fewer users and antennas (p. 12); the SNR sweep and the CSI-error sweep alone would not count. q5 is 0 because QuaDRiGa is a generator and no data or code link is given.
